description: Sandbox/firecracker leak detection: compare /proc-derived fc sandbox_id set vs orchestrator's authoritative running list. Surface zombie fc and orphan sandbox records.

panels.description: 集群中 fc 进程仍在运行但 orchestrator 已不认识的沙箱总数。即"有进程无记录"的泄漏。
panels.title: Firecracker 泄漏数(集群)

panels.description: Orchestrator 认为仍在运行但实际找不到 fc 进程的沙箱总数。即"有记录无进程"的孤儿。黄色需关注，红色需立即处理。
panels.title: 孤儿沙箱数(集群)

panels.description: 当前有至少一个泄漏 fc 进程的节点数量。帮助判断泄漏是集中在某个节点还是全集群范围。
panels.title: 存在泄漏的节点数

panels.description: 所有节点中最低的 Orchestrator 可达性——DOWN 表示某节点的 exporter 无法连接本地 Orchestrator，此时该节点的泄漏/孤儿数据不可信。
panels.title: Orchestrator 连通性(最差)

panels.description: 每节点的泄漏 fc 进程数。泄漏 = fc 进程仍在运行但 orchestrator 中无对应沙箱记录，通常是沙箱销毁时 fc 未被正确 kill。
panels.title: 各节点 Firecracker 泄漏数(有进程无记录)

panels.description: 每节点的孤儿沙箱数。孤儿 = orchestrator 认为沙箱在运行但找不到对应 fc 进程，通常是 fc 崩溃后状态未同步。
panels.title: 各节点孤儿沙箱数(有记录无进程)

panels.description: 泄漏的 sandbox_id + pid 列表，按 node_ip 排序方便批量处理。无泄漏时为空。

targets.rawSql:
SELECT sandbox_id,
  toString(argMax(sandbox_team_id, timestamp)) AS team_id,
  argMax(sandbox_template_id, timestamp) AS template_id,
  argMax(sandbox_build_id, timestamp) AS build_id,
  min(timestamp) AS first_seen,
  max(timestamp) AS last_seen
FROM sandbox_events
WHERE sandbox_id IN (${leak_ids:singlequote})
GROUP BY sandbox_id

panels.title: 当前泄漏清单(sandbox_id + pid，可用于定位 kill)

panels.description: 孤儿沙箱的 sandbox_id 列表。可用于在 orchestrator 中清理过期状态。

targets.rawSql:
SELECT sandbox_id,
  toString(argMax(sandbox_team_id, timestamp)) AS team_id,
  argMax(sandbox_template_id, timestamp) AS template_id,
  argMax(sandbox_build_id, timestamp) AS build_id,
  min(timestamp) AS first_seen,
  max(timestamp) AS last_seen
FROM sandbox_events
WHERE sandbox_id IN (${orphan_ids:singlequote})
GROUP BY sandbox_id

panels.title: 当前孤儿沙箱清单
